scoring_justification: Full DFT recompute infeasible in verifier; equilibrium properties checked against paper gold with tolerances; softening trend verified structurally.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference equilibrium V0/B0 values from paper (Sec. IV A); TO(Γ) frequencies from paper (Sec. IV B); TA(X) targets consistent with paper figures and reference DFT calculation.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Paper-reported LDA-PAW equilibrium properties and TO frequencies; TA(X) values extracted from reference solve.sh that models the softening in Figs. 7-8.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values trace directly to the published results; TA(X) chosen to represent the observed softening trend described in the paper.

outputs.description: Zero-pressure equilibrium volumes and bulk moduli for zincblende HgSe and HgTe obtained from a Murnaghan EOS fit to LDA total-energy data.
Selected phonon frequencies for zincblende HgSe and HgTe at zero pressure and at a compressed volume (~3 GPa), extracted from finite-displacement supercell calculations.

output_contract.notes: The pressure_condition in phonon_frequencies.csv should use the labels '0_GPa' and '3_GPa' (or equivalent). The TA(X) frequency at the compressed condition is expected to show softening (i.e., be significantly lower than the zero-pressure value).

steps.description: Check zero-pressure equilibrium volumes and bulk moduli against paper-reported LDA-PAW values with tolerances.
Verify TO(Γ) frequency matches paper (within 5%), and TA(X) softening: positive at 0 GPa, significantly lower (≤50% of zero-pressure value) at 3 GPa.
